title: New on OTT in India, Fri 13 Nov 2026: Heartland (Netflix), Student of the Year: After Dark (JioHotstar), Parivarik ManuRanjan (Sony LIV), Bandra (ZEE5)
headline: Heartland, Bandra and 2 More: New on OTT This Friday
caption:
Four of the new titles arriving on OTT in India on Friday, 13 November.

Netflix has Heartland, a Netflix original thriller in which Jessica Chastain plays a former country music star searching for her missing niece. JioHotstar starts Student of the Year: After Dark, a Hindi thriller series from Dharmatic Entertainment, directed by Reema Maya.

Sony LIV premieres Parivarik ManuRanjan, its original Hindi family comedy with Pankaj Tripathi and Aditi Rao Hydari, directed by Varun V. Sharma. ZEE5 adds Bandra, the Malayalam film starring Dileep and Tamannaah Bhatia.

How many of these four streaming services does your home pay for right now?

Sources: Netflix, Netflix Tudum, The Week, The Hollywood Reporter India, Sacnilk, Medianews4u, Esquire India, Daily Jagran
